about: Twenty runtime captures, driven by scripts/showcase.py. Three built sources: the early-slice village (one authored look), the blueprint proof harness (its own neutral studio, one record at a time) and the breadth bench (three catalog looks applied per view). look_applied says whether a catalog look was applied to that frame; a shot never claims a tier a record calls missing or not-proved.

shots.caption: The whole island from the app's home camera: inn, round tower, long hall, bridge and pond under the scene's dusk look, with the rock skirt and conifers as instanced background.
shots.tiers_note: tiers are the ladder the scene ships; the village LOD picks a level per landmark from camera distance each frame, so this is not a per-frame reading of what was drawn
